mkdir -p /var/backups/inventory /usr/local/sbin /var/log
cat > /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e

SRC_HOST="node2"
SRC_DIR="/srv/inventory/data"
DEST_ROOT="/var/backups/inventory"
RETAIN_DAYS=7
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
DEST_DIR="$DEST_ROOT/$DATE"
SSH_OPTS="-o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

rsync -a --delete -e "ssh $SSH_OPTS" "root@${SRC_HOST}:${SRC_DIR}/" "$DEST_DIR/"

find "$DEST_ROOT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -mtime "+$((RETAIN_DAYS - 1))" -exec rm -rf {} +

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) backup of ${SRC_HOST}:${SRC_DIR} -> ${DEST_DIR} completed" >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh
